newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca to boost insecticide output in UK.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca to boost insecticide output in UK.

text.p: British-based pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals group Zeneca Group Plc said on Wednesday it had decided to invest 22 million stg to expand and upgrade its international production plant for insecticides in England.

In a statement, Zeneca said it was experiencing strong worldwide demand for its products Force, Karate and Icon and was planning the investment to significantly increase both its pyrethroid capacity and manufacturing flexibility.
